svg.title: Listening triangle seat offset diagram
svg.desc: Speakers 1.8 m apart with a seat moved 25 cm left: the left path shrinks to 1.69 m and the right grows to 1.94 m, so left sound arrives 0.72 ms earlier and 1.2 dB louder.
